upcoming_elections_tamil_nadu.description: The current ongoing state elections to elect the 234 members of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly and determine the next Chief Minister.

upcoming_elections_tamil_nadu.expected_schedule: To be announced (Likely early to mid-2027)
upcoming_elections_tamil_nadu.description: Elections for city municipal corporations, municipalities, town panchayats, and village panchayats. Local bodies serve a 5-year term, with the last major urban local body polls having taken place in early 2022.
National elections to elect Members of Parliament (MPs) to the Lok Sabha. Tamil Nadu will vote to elect its 39 representatives to the national parliament.
